description: Quantum's journal class quantumarticle v6.1 (2022/11/08, CTAN and MiKTeX package quantumarticle, LPPL 1.3c), built on article. Options as the journal's template (quantum-template.tex: a4paper,twocolumn,11pt) without its accepted=<date> key, which prints an 'Accepted in Quantum' box for accepted papers; twocolumn is also the class default. a4paper is needed: without a paper size the class stops with a ClassError (quantumarticle.cls l.236-245). nopdfoutputerror is needed under XeTeX: without it the class ends with \pdfoutput=0 (l.1558), a pdfTeX primitive XeTeX lacks ('Undefined control sequence' in every document), and wraps \usepackage to stop when \pdfoutput=1 is missing (l.256-272); the option skips only those two checks. The class loads geometry and fancyhdr itself and silently skips a later \usepackage of geometry, fancyhdr, titlesec or authblk. It stops with a ClassError on a \usepackage of a font package (times, mathptmx, lmodern, newtx and others, l.1514-1556), on \today (an arXiv guard, l.296-308; allowtoday makes it a warning) and on font commands in \title. At \begin{document} it loads lmodern, which under XeTeX selects the TU Latin Modern fonts. General's \usepackage{lmodern} is left out (omitPreamble): the class's font blacklist stops on it (l.1540) and loads lmodern itself. The preamble takes revtex4-2-aps.json's \@mkpream@relax line: in two columns the class uses ltxutil's \switch@array, and p-column tables stop with "Extra \or" without it (batch 2 probe).
